No Clarity or vendor site. Results are tally sheets by voting box (BOX 101, 202, 303, 306, 404; EV and BBM are county-level columns), scanned. Last-Modified values differ per file and look like real upload times. The 2026 files are scanner PDFs with no CreationDate and no printed run time, so only server upload times are available; confidence low under the rule. Only the Republican files were read; Democratic files are listed alongside. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both END (check 2: one per-box unofficial sheet uploaded on election night), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT; the 2024 general is LATER. Confidence low because there is no printed run time to pair with the upload times.
